name: TC-11-purchase-receipt
description: TC-11.6: Purchase Receipt — Create and verify purchase receipt records

doc_metadata.title: TC-11.6 — Purchase Receipt List
doc_metadata.caption: Navigate to Purchase Receipt. Receipts record the delivery of goods against purchase orders and trigger vendor performance calculations.

doc_metadata.title: TC-11.6 — Receipt List Overview
doc_metadata.caption: The purchase receipt list shows all received deliveries with their PO reference, vendor, received date, and status.

doc_metadata.title: TC-11.6 — New Purchase Receipt
doc_metadata.caption: Click 'Add New' to record a receipt. Link it to a purchase order, enter received quantities, and note any discrepancies.

doc_metadata.title: TC-11.6 — Receipt Form
doc_metadata.caption: The purchase receipt form includes PO reference, vendor, delivery date, received items, quantities, and condition notes. Complete receipts update inventory and vendor performance metrics.
